evidence: effortField: lines[0] must be "---"; slices.Index(lines[1:], "---") returns an offset into the sub-slice, so the closing fence sits at lines[end+1] and lines[1:end+1] covers exactly the frontmatter lines. This is correct, including when the closing fence is the last line with no newline.
CR is trimmed from every line, so CRLF files are handled. A missing opening fence or a missing closing fence returns found=false, and the main test fails in both cases.
effortKey `^\s*["']?(effort|thinking)["']?\s*:` matches indented, quoted and space-before-colon keys, and does not match longer keys such as `effortless:`. All ten table cases agree with this logic.
The change touches only a test file, so it cannot affect production behavior.
